name: com.whatsonmiami/whats-on-miami
title: What's On Miami
description: What's on in Miami: events, hotel prices by night, Art Basel week, nightlife, things to do.

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: Events in Miami and Miami Beach between two dates (Art Basel and Miami Art Week, the Boat Show, Ultra, the Miami Open, the Orange Bowl, conventions, holidays) and what a typical hotel costs on the nights we checked. Defaults to the next 7 days.

tools.name: event_details
tools.description: One Miami event by name (e.g. "Art Basel", "Boat Show", "Ultra", "Miami Open", "Calle Ocho"): dates, venue, attendance, what hotels cost those nights against a quiet night, points or cash, the closest hotels, and links. Without a name, the biggest event in the next 30 days.

query.description: The event name or part of it; default the biggest event in the next 30 days

tools.name: hotel_prices
tools.description: What a typical Miami Beach or Brickell hotel costs on a given night, against a quiet midweek night, how many were sold out, what is on, and whether it is a night for hotel points or cash. If the night was not sampled, returns the nearest checked nights.

tools.name: best_nights
tools.description: The cheapest checked nights for a Miami hotel in a date range, with what is on those nights. Defaults to the next four months.

tools.name: art_week
tools.description: Art Basel Miami Beach and the fairs around it in Miami Art Week: each fair's dates, venue and site, and what hotels cost each night of the week.

tools.name: nightlife
tools.description: Miami nightclubs, pool parties, show venues and arenas open now (LIV, Club Space, M2 and more), where they are, their official sites, and the coming week's line-up from the club's own calendar where it publishes one.

query.description: Optional: a venue or DJ name

tools.name: real_places
tools.description: The real places in Miami and across Florida matched to the fictional Vice City in Grand Theft Auto VI's official trailers and, since its release on 19 November 2026, checked against published comparisons of the released game: what is there today, how to visit, how sure the match is (clearly shown, likely, a guess) and who made it. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

tools.name: things_to_do
tools.description: Things to do in and around Miami (the Everglades, Biscayne National Park, beaches, museums like Vizcaya and PAMM, Wynwood, Little Havana, the zoo, the Keys and free things), with prices from the official sites, how long to allow and how to get there.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Restaurants, things to do, nightlife, bars, coffee shops, museums and galleries in Miami that we list, filtered by neighbourhood, category and open now: address, open now or when it opens (Miami time), price, official site, booking link where the restaurant's own site gives one, and each place's page.

neighbourhood.description: Optional: a neighbourhood or area, e.g. "Wynwood", "Brickell", "South Beach", "Little Havana", "Coral Gables"

category.description: Optional: restaurants, things to do, nightlife, bars, coffee, museums, galleries; or narrower: rooftop, cocktail bar, wine bar, dive bar, brewery, cuban coffee, a cuisine (Cuban, Japanese…), michelin, bib gourmand, outdoors, culture, family, day-trips, free, club, pool party, show, arena

open_now.description: Optional: true for places open right now (Miami time); places without known hours are left out and counted

query.description: Optional: words in the name or description

tools.name: restaurants
tools.description: Miami restaurants we list (the MICHELIN Guide's stars and Bib Gourmands and the city's institutions), filtered by neighbourhood, cuisine, MICHELIN distinction and open now, with address, hours, price, official site and a booking link from the restaurant's own site.

neighbourhood.description: Optional: a neighbourhood or area, e.g. "Wynwood", "Brickell", "South Beach", "Little Havana", "Coral Gables"

cuisine.description: Optional: e.g. Cuban, Japanese, Italian, seafood, steakhouse

michelin.description: Optional: any MICHELIN distinction, starred only, or Bib Gourmand only

open_now.description: Optional: true for places open right now (Miami time); places without known hours are left out and counted

tools.name: place_details
tools.description: One restaurant, thing to do, nightlife venue, bar, coffee shop, museum or gallery by name: what it is, address, opening hours with their source and the date checked, open now, price, official site, booking link from its own site, the 3D map link, what is close by, sources and what we don't know.

query.description: The place's name or part of it (e.g. "Versailles", "Vizcaya", "LIV")

tools.name: neighborhood
tools.description: A Miami neighbourhood we have a guide for (Wynwood, Little Havana, Brickell, South Beach): what it is, the restaurants, things to do, nightlife, bars, coffee, museums and galleries inside its outline (with open now), the big events there, and the guide page. Without a name, the neighbourhoods we cover.

name.description: Optional: Wynwood, Little Havana, Brickell or South Beach

open_now.description: Optional: true for places open right now (Miami time); places without known hours are left out and counted

tools.name: sky_now
tools.description: How many aircraft are over Miami right now, how many are private jets, and which airports they are arriving at or leaving (MIA, FLL, Opa-locka, Miami Executive, Fort Lauderdale Executive). Live from adsb.lol.
